applicability: Valid for inputs matching the schema: digits is a nonempty list of 1..10 unique integers in 0..9, and max_length is an integer 1..4 not exceeding the number of distinct digits. Rejects malformed inputs, duplicates, out-of-range values, booleans, and max_length larger than the digit count with ValueError. Computes the count of distinct primes formable from 1..max_length distinct digits without repetition and without leading zeros.
description: Exhaustively enumerates all ordered selections of k distinct digits for k=1..max_length, skips leading-zero arrangements, forms the integer, and tests primality exactly by trial division up to the integer square root (6k±1 wheel after small cases). Counts distinct primes via a set. Deterministic, integer-only, and exact for the small search space. Uncertainty is minimal; the main assumptions are that max_length does not exceed the number of distinct digits and that digits are unique as required by the schema.
